contract_obligations.attribution: A shared image path or policy token names image/path context, not one unique concurrent process birth. Preserve per-execution source/native ancestry and refuse unsupported client/request attribution.
contract_obligations.builder: Keep current compilation for every preparation. Compare actual generated C and completed output bytes through checked descriptors before selecting an existing immutable image; do not skip compilation using an incomplete SDK key.
contract_obligations.capture: Bind exact wrapper/test/producer births and a checked private preparation receipt to the selected canonical image and qualified C. Reject arbitrary paths, changed images and stale/reused owners; preserve strict repeated-observation checks.
contract_obligations.failure: Retain first compilation, publication, identity, capacity, startup or cleanup failure without executable fallback, prewarming, original retry or deadline inflation.
contract_obligations.lifetime: Separate private compile/wrapper workspace retirement from shared-image lifetime. Define acquisition, release, maintenance and in-use eviction exclusion; an absent parent alone does not prove its descendants gone.
contract_obligations.policy: Current collectors and retained source validators use the process-supervisor-tests prefix. Any shared cache location needs explicit current collection support and versioned retained-format handling where required; existing v1 receipts remain frozen.
contract_obligations.publication: Specify repository-local location, fixed schema and capacity, exclusive complete publication, collision/partial-write handling, concurrent preparation, permission/descriptor custody and crash recovery before implementation. Never overwrite a published or observed image.
contract_obligations.resolution: Keep final canonical basename rustup. Existing private Cargo symlink can select it at the resolver boundary, but actual native execution and capture compatibility still require qualification.
